graph_assembly: three translated copies of the previous cell complex, exact rational cell masses, adjacency degree matrix
spectral_reference: arbitrary-precision generalized Eigensystem, mass-weighted orthonormalization within complete eigenvalue clusters
linear_reference: MatrixExp of the independently assembled finite generator
nonlinear_reference: NDSolveValue on real and imaginary scalar components; independent node fields and initial state
acceptance: Reuse all corresponding parent-protocol thresholds; use evolution.reference_agreement_max for both Wolfram precision refinement and SciPy/Wolfram agreement. Missing cases, runtime failure or malformed evidence are INCONCLUSIVE, never passed. No post-result threshold tuning.
ai_assistance: Codex-assisted Wolfram reference and cross-tool comparison; same authoring context, not independent human review.
